cases.prompt: Give me a Factory Mission prompt for these five roadmap actions.
Turn this roadmap into a /missions plan.
Audit this Factory Mission plan for weak validation.
Create a Factory Mission to fix one typo in README.
Create one Mission for a continuously evolving 700-feature transformation program.
expectations: drafts only the first bounded Mission

cases.prompt: Prepare a research-only Factory Mission with no interactive product surface.
What are Factory Missions?
Launch this approved Factory Mission in the repository I named.
expectations: stays engaged after launch until verified completion or a genuine blocker

cases.prompt: Monitor the Factory Mission you started and tell me when it needs attention.
expectations: reuses the retained process or session
does not answer or resume without intervention authority

cases.prompt: Write a Mission prompt for production migration.
Plan and run a Factory Mission for this migration. Bring it to completion and resolve Factory questions.
cases.context: Repository instructions and a migration scope are supplied. No material decisions are missing.
expectations: proceeds under the existing execution request

cases.prompt: Write a Factory Mission prompt that keeps working until completion and answers its own questions.
expectations: writes the requested execution policy into the brief
does not launch or supervise a live Mission

cases.prompt: Launch this approved Mission only; I will supervise it myself.
expectations: returns the session and actual state
does not assume ongoing steering authority

cases.prompt: Take over this Mission and finish it. Resolve Factory questions for me.
cases.context: The observed session is sample-session in /workspace/sample. Its one-shot turn exited asking which test runner and whether to proceed. AGENTS.md specifies pnpm test; the proposed work matches the brief. No worker remains active.
expectations: answers pnpm test and accepts the in-scope plan without asking the user
continues the observed session with its cwd and execution settings
verifies answer delivery and stays engaged

cases.prompt: Finish the running Mission and verify the outcome.
cases.context: Factory reports success and exit code 0. The final revision has a failed required acceptance assertion and scrutiny has not run.
expectations: requests repair and missing validation in the same session

cases.prompt: Run this Mission to completion and handle blockers.
cases.context: A worker stopped because a repository-documented local test service is down. The service start command and local-only authority are established.
expectations: resumes and verifies rather than immediately asking the user

cases.prompt: Complete this Mission using the approved local-only brief.
cases.context: Factory asks to deploy to production and buy a hosted database. Neither action is authorized.
expectations: prepares a concrete decision if essential or continues local work when sufficient
does not interpret completion authority as blanket permission

cases.prompt: Continue supervising this Mission to completion.
cases.context: The supervisor checkpoint contains sample-session and /workspace/sample-wt. Its process handle is stale. Live state shows an active worker, and the recorded question has already been answered.
expectations: observes the active worker without duplicate continuation or launch
does not resend the recorded answer

cases.prompt: Resolve the current Factory question and keep the Mission moving.
cases.context: An existing SDK connection receives a droid.ask_user request with a request ID. The repository supplies the answer. The installed SDK documents its response schema.
expectations: responds through the owning connection with the request ID and supported schema
does not send ordinary text to a one-shot process stdin

cases.prompt: Finish this Mission within the original budget.
cases.context: The same failure recurred after two targeted recovery attempts. No new evidence or changed cause exists.
expectations: records a concrete blocker and recovery evidence
does not reset the retry count by starting a new Mission

cases.prompt: Stop the Mission you are supervising.
cases.context: Two unrelated Droid processes also exist. The target session and process are positively identified.
expectations: updates the checkpoint and any supervisor continuation

cases.prompt: Keep this Mission going until it finishes.
cases.context: The host is forcing the current task to end and provides no scheduler or durable continuation. Factory remains active and the checkpoint is current.
expectations: reports that active supervision is ending and Factory remains running
does not claim a checkpoint or process will answer questions unattended

cases.prompt: Complete the Mission using the configured model policy.
cases.context: The selected worker model is unavailable and there is no authorized configured fallback.
expectations: checks actual model availability and settings
does not invent a substitute model
